title: Contains Duplicate III
description: Determine if there are two indices i and j such that abs(nums[i] - nums[j]) <= t and abs(i - j) <= k.
pseudocode:
1. buckets = {}
2. for i in range(len(nums)):
3.   bucket = nums[i] // (t + 1)
4.   if bucket in buckets: return True
5.   if bucket - 1 in buckets and abs(nums[i] - buckets[bucket - 1]) <= t: return True
6.   if bucket + 1 in buckets and abs(nums[i] - buckets[bucket + 1]) <= t: return True
7.   buckets[bucket] = nums[i]
8.   if i >= k: del buckets[nums[i - k] // (t + 1)]

steps.note: Bucket check passes, no duplicate found
